exposure: Emamectin benzoate (EMB) insecticide at doses of 4.4, 8.8 and 17.6 mg kgG-1 dayG-1
outcome: Morphological abnormalities (hydrocephaly, an ophthalmia, lung hypoplasia)
Skeletal abnormalities (incomplete ossification of cranial bones, aplasia of metacarpals, metatarsals, phalanges and caudal vertebrae)
cohort: Pregnant rats were divided into a control group and three groups orally administered Emamectin benzoate (EMB) from Gestation Day (GD) 6 through GD 15.
finding: Emamectin benzoate (EMB) given orally to pregnant rats at doses of 8.8 and 17.6 mg kgG-1 dayG-1 resulted in decreased maternal and fetal weight, increased fetal resorptions and post-implantation deaths, and significantly increased morphological, visceral, and skeletal abnormalities in fetuses.
birth_weight: Fetal weight decreased in exposed groups (8.8 and 17.6 mg kgG-1).
gest_age: Exposure occurred from Gestation Day (GD) 6 through GD 15, and fetuses were examined on GD 21.
